summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  **What I found by reading the code (no changes made):** - `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` — `watchlists.user_id` and all handler queries (`handlers.ts`) correctly filter every read/write by the authenticated user's id. No hardcoded/default/anonymous id anywhere. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — has its own auth middleware (`watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)`) that validates the session cookie and sets `X-User-Id` before every route. This mirrors the pattern other modules use, just applied on the sub-router instead of in `server.ts`.
